system.description: Vanish in silver smoke and reappear in a space you can see within 30'. This movement does not provoke Opportune Attacks.

outcomes.triumph: You defend with Boon against every attack made against you until the start of your next turn.
outcomes.success: The smoke lingers as your shape: you defend with Boon against the first attack made against you before your next turn.
outcomes.failure: You reappear, but the smoke scatters at once.
outcomes.ruin: You arrive with d4 persistent bleeding damage and are Slowed on your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
